caption: Before: the 2x2 MMI's two 8 µm-pitch ports per side render at the full Connect-mode marker size and merge into one blob per side (reproduction of the pre-fix constants on the same scene).
After: PinPitchSizer shrinks the markers to at most 45% of the port pitch, so all four MMI ports are visible as four separate Connect-mode markers.

Dense check on the shipped Full Adder example (full design): components tall enough to host their own label keep the classic inside-the-footprint anchor, so no label falls onto neighbouring components or waveguides.

Full Adder close-up at working zoom: group-child labels now go through the same declutter pass as top-level names, so of the two stacked flat 'Straight Waveguide 100µm' children exactly one label is drawn — no label covers another label.
